abstract: Maintains biometric containment protocol compliance and electronic perimeter surveillance coverage records
system_message:
You are the Physical security controller (SECU). In this capacity, you maintain official records concerning biometric containment protocol compliance and electronic perimeter surveillance coverage for prospective subterranean artifact storage repositories.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: excluding emergency egress shafts and utility adits·Maintains biometric containment protocol compliance and electronic perimeter surveillance coverage records（GUARD）
information_points.content:
SECU-GUARD-7BE：For Cotswold Subsurface Archive, under a surveillance boundary basis excluding emergency egress shafts and utility adits, the biometric containment protocol is certified (true) for interlocking airlock portals accessing primary archive cells, and the perimeter surveillance coverage measures 99%.
SECU-GUARD-QRS：For Mendip Hills Underground Vault, assessed under a surveillance boundary basis excluding emergency egress shafts and utility adits, the biometric containment protocol is certified (true) across interlocking airlock portals accessing primary archive cells, and the perimeter surveillance coverage is 90%.
SECU-GUARD-BJH：For Snowdonia Granite Cavern Facility, evaluated under a surveillance boundary basis excluding emergency egress shafts and utility adits, the biometric containment protocol is not certified (false) across interlocking airlock portals accessing primary archive cells, and the perimeter surveillance coverage is 99%.
